# Pitch Deck Visual Generator

Turn your startup into six pitch deck slide visuals designed as one deck, returned as images from your ManyMotions account.

## What it does

Describe what the startup does, the problem it solves, its target market and its business model. Claude prepares the request and shows the credits required. When you confirm, ManyMotions plans the deck and renders six slides: problem, solution, market, product, business model and the ask.

**AI generation:** the media are generated by AI models run by ManyMotions and its model providers. Nothing is generated until you ask for it, and the credits required are shown first.

Slide visuals from your own startup description only: no uploaded decks, logos or images, and no other companies' logos or trademarks on the slides.

## Setup

The plugin connects Claude to the ManyMotions MCP server at `https://manymotions.com/api/claude/pitch-deck-generator/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).

- Preparing a request is free and works without an account.
- The first render asks you to sign in to ManyMotions (OAuth with PKCE; you can create an account on the same page). Rendering needs verified paid access and available credits on the account.
- A deck takes a few minutes: Claude reports the progress, then returns the slide image links. Claude Code works the same way, with text and links.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `prepare_pitch_deck` | Prepare the deck: startup, problem, market, business model. Free, no sign-in. |
| `generate_result` | Start the slides. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_result` | Report progress, then return the slide image links. Read-only. |

## Example prompts

- "Pitch deck for a startup that rents solar kits to apartment renters"
- "Six slides for our B2B app that automates restaurant inventory, subscription model"
- "Investor deck visuals for a marketplace connecting local tutors with families"

## Data and privacy

Your prompts and settings are sent to ManyMotions and stored in your ManyMotions account, and they are sent to the model providers that render the media. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.

- Privacy policy: https://manymotions.com/privacy
- Terms of service: https://manymotions.com/terms
- Documentation: https://manymotions.com/mcp#pitch-deck-generator
- Support: https://manymotions.com/support

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
